reason: Single well-circumscribed mass in the left posterolateral buttock (91 mL, z 89-161). The outline follows the lesion edge in axial, coronal and sagittal views and the past-the-mask panels show no lesion tissue. Candidate shells are surrounding fat and muscle, so they were rejected. Lesion identity as lipomatous is the main uncertainty: the signal is heterogeneous and brighter than subcutaneous fat, and the midline mottled structure and bright oval were judged to be bowel and fluid.
